name: SatNOGS DB RF Transmitter Source Nodes
description: SatNOGS DB (Libre Space Foundation) -> SDS $RFB transmitter records. Two pure flow nodes: `request` turns a cron timer tick into ONE whole-table hostcap/http-request GET of https://db.satnogs.org/api/transmitters/?format=json (bulk, never a pagination walk — the source-policy.json crawl ruling) plus the parser attribution job; `parse` joins that job with the http response, decodes ~4,994 transmitter rows and emits a size-prefixed $RFB record stream for hostcap/storage-ingest. One $RFB record carries exactly one LINK_DIRECTION, so a Transceiver/Transponder becomes an UPLINK + DOWNLINK pair sharing ID_TRANSMITTER (the SatNOGS uuid). SatNOGS publishes HERTZ; every frequency field written is MHz per the normative RFB units rule. Licence is CC-BY-SA-4.0: every record carries CITATION verbatim and the batch provenance carries license/license_url/citation so the share-alike obligation survives republication. No capabilities: this node performs no I/O — http and storage are the generic hostcap connector nodes.

sequentialJustification.detail: Both methods are pure single-pass transforms over one fetched JSON table: `request` formats a fetch descriptor from node CONFIG, and `parse` walks the SatNOGS transmitter rows once, emitting one or two $RFB records per row into a single append-only stream. There is no shared mutable state, no worker pool, no fan-out and nothing for a second thread to do; the whole cost is one linear scan of a ~3.5 MB body. This guest can never spawn a thread, so it compiles clang/wasi-sequential rather than claiming a wasi-threads contract it does not honour.

methods.description: Builds the SatNOGS DB transmitters fetch request + parse job from a timer tick. ONE whole-table request per cycle with the source-policy.json identifying UA and conditional-request validators from node CONFIG.

wildcardJustification.detail: Cron timer tick frame produced by the flow runtime and consumed inside this flow only; it carries no payload at all, so there is no SDS record to name.

acceptedTypeSets.description: UTF-8 JSON http request for the SatNOGS transmitters table.

wildcardJustification.detail: hostcap/http-request request descriptor ({method,url,headers,timeoutMs}) produced and consumed inside this flow; its shape is defined by the host http.request op, not by SDS.
Fetch-job attribution ({source_url,source_name,provider_id,archive_*}) produced and consumed inside this flow; it is ingest bookkeeping, never persisted as a record.

methods.description: Decodes the SatNOGS transmitters JSON table into a size-prefixed $RFB record stream (one record per link direction, Hz -> MHz, POLARIZATION explicitly UNKNOWN, CITATION carrying the CC-BY-SA-4.0 attribution) plus the storage.ingest_with_source meta and the raw payload for archiving.

wildcardJustification.detail: Fetch-job attribution ({source_url,source_name,provider_id,archive_*}) emitted by this module's own request node inside the same flow; ingest bookkeeping, never persisted.

inputPorts.description: Fetch-job attribution from the request node.

wildcardJustification.detail: hostcap/http-request response frame ({status,headers,bodyB64}) consumed inside this flow; its shape is defined by the host http.request op, not by SDS.

inputPorts.description: The HTTP response carrying the SatNOGS transmitters table.

acceptedTypeSets.description: UTF-8 JSON storage.ingest_with_source meta for the RFB batch, carrying licence-bearing provenance.

wildcardJustification.detail: storage.ingest_with_source meta (schema, provider/source/url/batch attribution, reconcile mode, archive naming, licence-bearing provenance) consumed by hostcap/storage-ingest inside this flow.

acceptedTypeSets.description: The decoded source payload bytes (for raw archiving).

wildcardJustification.detail: The verbatim SatNOGS DB transmitters table as fetched: vendor JSON from db.satnogs.org, archived byte-for-byte for provenance. It is an external wire format with no SDS identity.
